headline: BOYNEXTDOOR wrap first North America tour, all sold out
sub: 10 cities from Dallas to Mexico City, Asia leg starts Dec 5

points.title: What to know
items: Stops incl. NYC, Toronto, Chicago and LA
Taipei and Hong Kong added extra dates

source: Source: KOZ Entertainment via Korean media
caption:
BOYNEXTDOOR have wrapped their first-ever North America tour, and every single show sold out.

The 'KNOCK ON Vol.2' North American leg hit 10 cities, from Dallas, Pompano Beach, Chicago, New York and Toronto to Vancouver, Seattle, San Francisco and Los Angeles, before closing in Mexico City on Nov 24 (local time). The members said the crowd was so loud "it broke through our in-ear monitors" and promised to come back even better. Next up: the Asia tour opens Dec 5 in Jakarta, with Kuala Lumpur, Taipei, Hong Kong, Singapore and Bangkok to follow.

📌 Source: KOZ Entertainment, via Korean media (Newsen, News Culture)
